messages:
ida: quick sync  proto negotiation vs json-first at the gateway. need a rollout path that minimizes client changes but keeps clean telemetry. cc @ram @lee

ram: json-first keeps product teams happy. proto-first reduces server load and tail, but impacts browser clients.

lee: if we do negotiation, we must tag traces and split metrics by path. otherwise SRE alerts will be noisy.

ida: agreed. proposal: default json ingress + negotiate via x-rw-proto header or ALPN when available. gateway will set trace tag edge.negotiated_proto=true when proto used.

ram: perf note from spike: proto path saved ~6% CPU and cut 95p by ~4ms for small RPCs. transcode added ~2-4ms.

lee: important: map claim headers into proto metadata and emit metric header_present:boolean. add unit test for header-preservation.

ida: rollout plan: enable negotiation in gateway, console per-tenant toggle, 10% canary for 24h, monitor p95, quota-mismatch-rate, header-drop-rate -> decide.

infra-bot: canary started: gateway-negotiate-v1 -> beta-group (10%) at 3758010006

ram: ok. i'll prep SDK note: native sets ALPN, browser sets x-rw-proto behind opt-in flag.

lee: i'll wire dashboard tiles and alerts: header-drop > 0.05% -> slack notify; quota-mismatch > 0.1% -> page oncall.

ida: thanks everyone  i'll open RFC and PR with route schema and test checklist.
